capabilities: Fetch Telegram messages into a target note via a sync server
Deploy a personal sync server on Amvera or use the default shared one
Save message media to an attachments folder
Transcribe voice and audio files via ProxyAPI
Render each message from a template file with variables
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not sync a vault across devices; it imports Telegram messages into a target note.
extras: Offers a default shared bot and server so users can sync without deploying anything; messages are deleted from the server after a successful sync; audio transcription is limited to 25 MB files; documentation is provided in both English and Russian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture messages sent to Telegram, including voice messages and photos, as notes in the vault.

relations.evidence: An Obsidian plugin that syncs messages from your personal Telegram bot into your vault.
Messages first go to your sync server on Amvera, where they are stored until you sync them
Optionally, voice and audio can be transcribed via ProxyAPI.
You can bind this command to a Buttons plugin button.

requires.name: Amvera hosting (for a custom server; a default shared server is available)

summary: Pulls messages from a personal Telegram bot into vault notes via an Amvera-hosted sync server, with optional voice transcription via ProxyAPI.
